next_planned_experiment.name: OSCAR 2-bit KV in HF transformers (no SGLang)
next_planned_experiment.rationale: HQQ-2bit unusable; TQ-4bit too slow; OSCAR's spectral-rotation should make 2-bit viable. Pair with delta-mem.
next_planned_experiment.scope: Port OSCAR's rotation + INT2 per-token asymmetric quantization (group size 64; sink + recent tokens kept FP16) from sglang-research into a transformers.cache_utils.Cache subclass. Then compute Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 rotations (3-phase: dump Q/K/V -> fit -> eval; OSCAR's RotationZoo on HF has Thinking variant but not Instruct). Re-run conv-0/10q against bf16+delta and TQ4+delta baselines.
next_planned_experiment.deliverable_repo: user wants this as a new public repo (eg oscar-transformers); track here as a git submodule
next_planned_experiment.implementation_path: 1) PyTorch reference implementation (slow, correct). 2) Optimise with Triton or CUDA kernels — candidate for AutoKernel-driven generation.

blockers.description: OSCAR ships only as SGLang patches, not a transformers library. Port required.
blockers.workaround: Port the rotation+quantize math into a transformers.Cache subclass

blockers.description: RotationZoo on HF has Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 but not Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. We use the Instruct variant.
blockers.workaround: Run the 3-phase rotation calibration ourselves on the Instruct model. Costs hours of GPU.

blockers.description: optimum-quanto's CUDA extension uses GCC __asm__ inline assembly; doesn't compile on MSVC.
blockers.workaround: Skip optimum-quanto on Windows; use hqq for the HF QuantizedCache path. Documented in env/README.md.

decisions_made.decision: Next experiment is OSCAR port to transformers Cache subclass, NOT full SGLang integration
decisions_made.rationale: SGLang integration would require porting delta-mem (which is an HF attention-replacement adapter) into SGLang's CUDA kernels — multi-week project blocked on bigger hardware. Porting OSCAR math to HF is the cheaper move.

next_action: If continuing OSCAR port: (1) create a new public repo (suggested: oscar-transformers). (2) Add as submodule under e.g. third_party/oscar-transformers. (3) Read delta-Mem-tests/notes/ for the integration touchpoints; design TurboQuantCache-like API: from oscar_transformers import OSCARCache; cache = OSCARCache(rotation_path=..., bits=2). (4) Step 1 of porting: pull the rotation matrices from RotationZoo (Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507) and trial them on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 — if they work approximately, we save the 3-phase calibration. (5) If not, run sglang-research's dump/fit pipeline on Instruct.
context_notes: We followed the user's plan exactly: prove 2-bit + delta-mem fits before porting OSCAR. Context budget on the assistant got low (65%+) which is why we paused — pick up in a fresh session for the OSCAR port itself.
